# Step 8. Pairs, statistics and figures

```{r step8}
###############################################################################
# 08_compare_figures.R - ICESat-2 and GEDI against the ALS metrics of the Québec PEP plots (province-wide)
#
# Author:    João Paulo Czarnecki de Liz (developer)
# Co-author: Claude (Anthropic), AI coding assistant
# Licence:   MIT (see LICENSE)
#
# A pair = one satellite sample within 100 m of one plot centre, after the default quality filters (GEDI
# leaf-on flag and sensitivity >= 0.95; ATL08 strong beams, snow-free), June-September 2019-2025.
# Compared metrics (plot ALS from data/plot_als_metrics.csv, 11.28 m plots):
#   GEDI RH95        <-> plot P95 of all returns (zq95)   same definition
#   GEDI RH50        <-> plot P50 (zq50)                  same definition
#   ATL08 h_canopy   <-> plot P95 (zq95)                  close, not identical (P98 of canopy photons over 100 m)
# "On the plot": a GEDI footprint overlapping the plot (centre <= 25 m); an ICESat-2 segment crossing it
# (tracks run nearly north-south here: |east offset| <= 18 m and |north offset| <= 61 m).
# Delay = satellite date - ALS date (years; negative when the satellite came first). A pair is "disturbed" when
# an MRNF harvest, partial cut, fire or other event falls between the ALS year and the satellite year.
# 95% intervals: bootstrap over plots (the pairs of one plot share its ALS and its ground).
#
# Run    Rscript scripts/08_compare_figures.R          (~5 min)
# Inputs data/derived/plots_province.csv, plot_events_2010plus.csv (step 7);
#        data/derived/gedi02a_plots.csv, atl08_plots.csv (step 5) or the copies provided in data/satellite/
# Output docs/assets/img/P1-P4_*.png (the figures of the site), outputs/*.csv, outputs/numbers.txt
###############################################################################
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(sf); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(data.table); library(scales) })
sf_use_s2(FALSE); invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C"))
ROOT <- Sys.getenv("EXERCISE_ROOT", ".")
DAT  <- file.path(ROOT, "data/derived")
FIG  <- Sys.getenv("FIG_DIR", file.path(ROOT, "docs/assets/img")); OUTP <- Sys.getenv("OUT_DIR", file.path(ROOT, "outputs"))
dir.create(FIG, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(OUTP, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
sat_file <- function(f) { p <- file.path(DAT, f); if (file.exists(p)) p else file.path(ROOT, "data/satellite", f) }
# (the helpers of that file are defined in the 'Helpers' chunks at the top)
set.seed(1)
NUM <- file.path(OUTP, "numbers.txt"); cat("", file = NUM)
say <- function(...) { s <- sprintf(...); cat(s, "\n"); cat(s, "\n", file = NUM, append = TRUE) }

# --- look -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SENSOR <- c("GEDI L2A" = "#eb6834", "ICESat-2 ATL08" = "#2a78d6")
FT_PAL <- c("Softwood" = "#1f7a4d", "Mixed" = "#7d55d0", "Hardwood" = "#c47a00", "Open / regenerating" = "#8e8e8e")
LEAF_ON  <- "Leaf-on ALS (June–September)"
LEAF_OFF <- "Leaf-off or transition ALS (April–May, October–December)"
SEASON_PAL <- setNames(c("#5b8c00", "#c2479a"), c(LEAF_ON, LEAF_OFF))
EV_PAL <- c("No MRNF event" = "#333333", "Harvest, cut or fire in between" = "#c2479a")
INK2 <- "grey35"
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                  plot.title.position = "plot", plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2),
                  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "grey88")))
save <- function(p, f, w, h) { ggsave(file.path(FIG, f), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 200, bg = "white"); cat("  wrote", f, "\n") }
fmt  <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
rmse <- function(x) sqrt(mean(x^2))
st   <- function(s, a) { d <- s - a; data.table(n = length(d), r = cor(s, a), bias = mean(d), rmse = rmse(d), mae = mean(abs(d))) }
lab  <- function(x) sprintf("n = %s pairs (%s plots)\nr = %.2f\nbias = %+.1f m\nRMSE = %.1f m", fmt(x$n), fmt(x$plots), x$r, x$bias, x$rmse)
boot_plot <- function(d, fun, B = 300) {                 # 95% interval, resampling whole plots
  if (!nrow(d)) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$plot_id)
  v <- replicate(B, fun(d[unlist(idx[sample(length(idx), replace = TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)]))
  as.numeric(quantile(v, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# --- data -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
P <- fread(file.path(DAT, "plots_province.csv"))
P[, als_date := as.Date(als_date)]
P[, als_season := factor(fifelse(als_month %in% 6:9, LEAF_ON, LEAF_OFF), levels = c(LEAF_ON, LEAF_OFF))]
P[, forest_type := factor(forest_type, levels = names(FT_PAL))]
EV <- fread(file.path(DAT, "plot_events_2010plus.csv"))
pxy <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(P, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326), 32198))
P[, `:=`(px = pxy[, 1], py = pxy[, 2])]

prep <- function(file, product, sensor) {
  d <- as.data.table(lidar_filter(read_lidar(file), product))
  xy <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(d[, .(lon, lat)], coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326), 32198))
  d[, `:=`(sx = xy[, 1], sy = xy[, 2], sat_date = as.Date(substr(as.character(time), 1, 10)), sensor = sensor)]
  d <- merge(d, P[, .(plot_id, px, py, plon = longitude, plat = latitude, als_date, als_year, als_season, forest_type,
                      dom_bio, zq95, zq50, zmax)], by = "plot_id")
  d[, `:=`(dist = sqrt((sx - px)^2 + (sy - py)^2), gap = as.numeric(sat_date - als_date) / 365.25,
           dE = (lon - plon) * cos(plat * pi / 180) * 111320, dN = (lat - plat) * 110574)]
  d <- d[dist <= 100 & month(sat_date) %in% 6:9]
  d[, on_plot := if (product == "atl08") abs(dE) <= 18 & abs(dN) <= 61 else dist <= 25]
  e <- merge(d[, .(row = .I, plot_id, y0 = pmin(als_year, year(sat_date)), y1 = pmax(als_year, year(sat_date)))], EV,
             by = "plot_id", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[year >= y0 & year <= y1]
  d[, event := "No MRNF event"]; d[unique(e$row), event := "Harvest, cut or fire in between"]
  d
}
G <- prep(sat_file("gedi02a_plots.csv"), "gedi02a", "GEDI L2A")
A <- prep(sat_file("atl08_plots.csv"), "atl08", "ICESat-2 ATL08")
G[, `:=`(sat = rh95, als = zq95)]; A[, `:=`(sat = h, als = zq95)]
fwrite(G[, .(plot_id, time, beam, dist, on_plot, gap, event, rh95, rh50, rh98, zq95, zq50, sensitivity, forest_type, als_season)],
       file.path(OUTP, "pairs_gedi.csv"))
fwrite(A[, .(plot_id, time_ns, spot, dist, dE, dN, on_plot, gap, event, h, zq95, forest_type, als_season)], file.path(OUTP, "pairs_atl08.csv"))
say("Plots with ALS metrics: %s (south of 51.6N: %s)", fmt(nrow(P)), fmt(sum(P$latitude < 51.6)))
say("Pairs within 100 m after filters: GEDI %s (%s plots), ATL08 %s (%s plots)",
    fmt(nrow(G)), fmt(uniqueN(G$plot_id)), fmt(nrow(A)), fmt(uniqueN(A$plot_id)))

###############################################################################
# P1 How many plots have a satellite sample nearby
###############################################################################
cat("figure P1\n")
cnt <- rbindlist(lapply(c(12.5, 25, 50, 100), function(r) rbind(
  data.table(sensor = "GEDI L2A", r = r, plots = uniqueN(G[dist <= r]$plot_id), pairs = nrow(G[dist <= r])),
  data.table(sensor = "ICESat-2 ATL08", r = r, plots = uniqueN(A[dist <= r]$plot_id), pairs = nrow(A[dist <= r])))))
fwrite(cnt, file.path(OUTP, "table_plots_with_samples.csv"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cnt))) with(cnt[i], say("%s within %.1f m: %s plots, %s pairs", sensor, r, fmt(plots), fmt(pairs)))
onG <- unique(G[on_plot == TRUE]$plot_id); onA <- unique(A[on_plot == TRUE]$plot_id)
say("Plots with a sample ON the plot: GEDI %s (%s pairs), ICESat-2 %s (%s pairs), both %s",
    fmt(length(onG)), fmt(sum(G$on_plot)), fmt(length(onA)), fmt(sum(A$on_plot)), fmt(length(intersect(onG, onA))))
qc <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "Canada", returnclass = "sf")
qc <- qc[qc$name %in% c("Québec", "Quebec"), ]
P[, near := factor(fifelse(plot_id %in% onG & plot_id %in% onA, "Both",
                    fifelse(plot_id %in% onG, "GEDI only", fifelse(plot_id %in% onA, "ICESat-2 only", "Neither"))),
                   levels = c("Neither", "ICESat-2 only", "GEDI only", "Both"))]
NEAR_PAL <- c("Neither" = "grey80", "ICESat-2 only" = SENSOR[[2]], "GEDI only" = SENSOR[[1]], "Both" = "black")
p1a <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = qc, fill = "grey97", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = P[order(near)], aes(longitude, latitude, colour = near), size = 0.4, shape = 16) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 51.6, colour = SENSOR[[1]], linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = -79.6, y = 51.85, label = "GEDI stops at 51.6°N", hjust = 0, size = 2.7, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = NEAR_PAL, name = "Sample on the plot:") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5))) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-80, -57), ylim = c(44.8, 53), crs = 4326) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "a  Plots with a satellite sample on top of them",
       subtitle = sprintf("%s PEP plots with ALS metrics. Satellites: June–September 2019–2025, default filters.\nGEDI footprint overlapping the plot; ICESat-2 segment crossing it.", fmt(nrow(P))))
cnt[, sensor := factor(sensor, levels = names(SENSOR))]
p1b <- ggplot(cnt, aes(factor(r), plots, fill = sensor)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt(plots)), position = position_dodge(0.75), vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, colour = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SENSOR, name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "Distance from the plot centre (m)", y = "Plots with at least one sample", title = "b  How many plots, by distance",
       subtitle = "Plot radius 11.28 m; GEDI footprint radius 12.5 m") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
save((p1a | p1b) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.5, 1)), "P1_plots_with_samples.png", 12.5, 6.2)

###############################################################################
# P2 Agreement on the plot, and how it degrades with distance
###############################################################################
cat("figure P2\n")
NEAR_GAP <- 2                                                       # |delay| <= 2 years
core <- function(d) d[on_plot == TRUE & abs(gap) <= NEAR_GAP & event == "No MRNF event"]
Gc <- core(G); Ac <- core(A)
sG <- cbind(st(Gc$sat, Gc$als), plots = uniqueN(Gc$plot_id)); sA <- cbind(st(Ac$sat, Ac$als), plots = uniqueN(Ac$plot_id))
sG50 <- cbind(st(Gc$rh50, Gc$zq50), plots = uniqueN(Gc$plot_id))
say("On the plot, |delay| <= %d y, no event. GEDI RH95 vs zq95: %s plots, n=%d, r=%.2f, bias=%+.2f, RMSE=%.2f, MAE=%.2f | RH50 vs zq50: r=%.2f, bias=%+.2f, RMSE=%.2f",
    NEAR_GAP, fmt(sG$plots), sG$n, sG$r, sG$bias, sG$rmse, sG$mae, sG50$r, sG50$bias, sG50$rmse)
say("On the plot, |delay| <= %d y, no event. ATL08 h_canopy vs zq95: %s plots, n=%d, r=%.2f, bias=%+.2f, RMSE=%.2f, MAE=%.2f",
    NEAR_GAP, fmt(sA$plots), sA$n, sA$r, sA$bias, sA$rmse, sA$mae)
for (q in list(list("GEDI", Gc), list("ATL08", Ac))) {
  x <- q[[2]][, .(e = sat - als)]
  say("  %s error quantiles (5, 25, 50, 75, 95%%): %s; share |error| > 5 m: %.0f%%", q[[1]],
      paste(sprintf("%+.1f", quantile(x$e, c(.05, .25, .5, .75, .95))), collapse = ", "), 100 * mean(abs(x$e) > 5))
}
sc <- function(d, s, sen, xl, yl, title) {
  lim <- c(0, quantile(c(d$sat, d$als), 0.998))
  ggplot(d, aes(als, sat)) + geom_bin2d(binwidth = c(1, 1)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#efefef", high = SENSOR[[sen]], trans = "log10", name = "Pairs") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("label", x = lim[1], y = lim[2], label = lab(s), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.7, fill = alpha("white", 0.85),
             border.colour = NA, colour = "grey15") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) + labs(x = xl, y = yl, title = title) + theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"))
}
p2a <- sc(Gc, sG, "GEDI L2A", "Plot ALS P95 (m)", "GEDI RH95 (m)", "a  GEDI footprint overlapping the plot")
p2b <- sc(Ac, sA, "ICESat-2 ATL08", "Plot ALS P95 (m)", "ATL08 h_canopy (m)", "b  ICESat-2 segment crossing the plot")
RINGS <- c(0, 12.5, 25, 50, 75, 100)
ring_tab <- function(d, sen) rbindlist(lapply(2:length(RINGS), function(k) {
  x <- d[dist > RINGS[k - 1] & dist <= RINGS[k] & abs(gap) <= NEAR_GAP & event == "No MRNF event"]
  b <- boot_plot(x, function(y) rmse(y$sat - y$als))
  data.table(sensor = sen, r = RINGS[k], rmse = if (nrow(x)) rmse(x$sat - x$als) else NA_real_, lo = b[1], hi = b[2], n = nrow(x))
}))
DB <- rbind(ring_tab(G, "GEDI L2A"), ring_tab(A, "ICESat-2 ATL08"))[n >= 20]
DB[, sensor := factor(sensor, levels = names(SENSOR))]
fwrite(DB, file.path(OUTP, "table_rmse_by_distance.csv"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(DB))) with(DB[i], say("RMSE by distance ring, %s, to %.1f m: %.2f m (%.2f-%.2f), n=%d", sensor, r, rmse, lo, hi, n))
p2c <- ggplot(DB, aes(r, rmse, colour = sensor)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 2) + scale_colour_manual(values = SENSOR, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = RINGS[-1]) + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Distance ring from the plot centre (outer edge, m)", y = "RMSE against plot ALS P95 (m)",
       title = "c  Error by distance from the plot", subtitle = "Rings 0–12.5, 12.5–25, 25–50, 50–75, 75–100 m") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save((p2a | p2b | p2c) + plot_annotation(
  title = "When a satellite sample falls on an inventory plot, how close is it to the plot's ALS?",
  subtitle = sprintf("ALS and satellite within %d years of each other, no MRNF harvest, cut or fire in between. GEDI RH95 and the plot P95 have the same definition;\nATL08 h_canopy (98th percentile of canopy photons over 100 m) is close but not identical. 95%% intervals: bootstrap over plots.", NEAR_GAP),
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))), "P2_agreement_at_the_plot.png", 15, 5.8)

###############################################################################
# P3 Delay between the ALS and the satellite: how much uncertainty it adds
###############################################################################
# Across plots the delay is confounded with the region (each region was flown in a different year). Two ways
# around it: (a, b) one line per ALS period, so that each line follows the same plots through the satellite
# years; (numbers) a within-plot estimate, from plots seen on the plot at two or more different delays.
cat("figure P3\n")
ALS_GRP <- function(y) cut(y, c(2008, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2025),
                           labels = c("2009–2016", "2017–2018", "2019–2020", "2021–2022", "2023–2025"))
GRP_PAL <- setNames(c("#c9c0f2", "#a99bec", "#7d68dc", "#5340b8", "#2c1f7a"), levels(ALS_GRP(2010)))
DELAY_R <- 50; WITHIN_R <- 100        # samples used for the delay lines / for the within-plot estimate (m)
mk <- function(r) { x <- rbind(G[dist <= r, .(sensor, plot_id, gap, als_year, event, e = sat - als)],
                               A[dist <= r, .(sensor, plot_id, gap, als_year, event, e = sat - als)])
  x[, `:=`(gbin = round(gap), grp = ALS_GRP(als_year), sensor = factor(sensor, levels = names(SENSOR)))][] }
DD <- mk(DELAY_R); DW <- mk(WITHIN_R)
T3 <- DD[event == "No MRNF event", { b1 <- boot_plot(.SD, function(x) rmse(x$e)); b2 <- boot_plot(.SD, function(x) mean(x$e))
  .(rmse = rmse(e), rmse_lo = b1[1], rmse_hi = b1[2], bias = mean(e), bias_lo = b2[1], bias_hi = b2[2], n = .N, plots = uniqueN(plot_id)) },
  by = .(sensor, grp, gbin)][n >= 20]
fwrite(T3, file.path(OUTP, "table_error_by_delay.csv"))
within_plot <- function(d) {                    # slopes after removing each plot's own mean
  d <- d[event == "No MRNF event" & abs(e) < 15]
  d <- d[, if (uniqueN(gbin) >= 2) .SD, by = plot_id]
  if (uniqueN(d$plot_id) < 20) return(NULL)
  d[, `:=`(e2 = e^2, ag = abs(gap))]
  d[, `:=`(e2d = e2 - mean(e2), agd = ag - mean(ag), ed = e - mean(e), gd = gap - mean(gap)), by = plot_id]
  slope <- function(x) c(sum(x$e2d * x$agd) / sum(x$agd^2), sum(x$ed * x$gd) / sum(x$gd^2))
  est <- slope(d); idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), d$plot_id)
  b <- replicate(300, slope(d[unlist(idx[sample(length(idx), replace = TRUE)])]))
  r0 <- sqrt(mean(d[ag <= 1]$e2))
  list(n = nrow(d), plots = uniqueN(d$plot_id), b2 = est[1], b2_ci = quantile(b[1, ], c(.025, .975), na.rm = TRUE),
       drift = est[2], drift_ci = quantile(b[2, ], c(.025, .975), na.rm = TRUE), r0 = r0,
       r5 = sqrt(max(r0^2 + 5 * est[1], 0)), r10 = sqrt(max(r0^2 + 10 * est[1], 0)))
}
W <- list()
for (sn in names(SENSOR)) {
  W[[sn]] <- w <- within_plot(DW[sensor == sn])
  if (is.null(w)) say("Within-plot delay, %s: fewer than 20 plots seen at two or more delays", sn)
  else say("Within-plot delay, %s: %d pairs on %d plots; squared error %+.2f m2/yr (95%% %.2f to %.2f) -> RMSE %.2f m at <= 1 yr, %.2f at 5, %.2f at 10; difference drifts %+.2f m/yr (%.2f to %.2f)",
           sn, w$n, w$plots, w$b2, w$b2_ci[1], w$b2_ci[2], w$r0, w$r5, w$r10, w$drift, w$drift_ci[1], w$drift_ci[2])
  x <- DD[sensor == sn]
  say("  %s within %d m: %.1f%% of pairs with an MRNF event in between; RMSE %.2f m with, %.2f m without",
      sn, DELAY_R, 100 * mean(x$event != "No MRNF event"), rmse(x[event != "No MRNF event"]$e), rmse(x[event == "No MRNF event"]$e))
}
WL <- rbindlist(lapply(names(SENSOR), function(sn) { w <- W[[sn]]
  data.table(sensor = factor(sn, levels = names(SENSOR)),
             lab = if (is.null(w)) "Too few plots seen at several delays" else
               sprintf("Within-plot estimate (samples ≤ %d m): RMSE %.1f m at ≤ 1 year,\n%.1f m at 5 years, %.1f m at 10 years (%s plots)", WITHIN_R, w$r0, w$r5, w$r10, fmt(w$plots))) }))
p3a <- ggplot(T3, aes(gbin, rmse, colour = grp)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_text(data = WL, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.03, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.7, colour = "grey15") +
  facet_wrap(~sensor, drop = FALSE) + scale_colour_manual(values = GRP_PAL, name = "ALS flown in", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.3))) + expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RMSE against plot ALS P95 (m)", title = "a  Uncertainty against the delay",
       subtitle = "One line per ALS period: along a line the plots are the same and only the satellite year changes. Pairs without an MRNF event; points with < 20 pairs hidden.")
p3b <- ggplot(T3, aes(gbin, bias, colour = grp)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~sensor, drop = FALSE) + scale_colour_manual(values = GRP_PAL, guide = "none", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Delay: satellite date − ALS date (years; negative = satellite first)", y = "Mean difference,\nsatellite − ALS (m)",
       title = "b  Mean difference against the delay (growth shows as a rising line)")
T3e <- DD[, .(rmse = rmse(e), n = .N), by = .(sensor, event)]
T3e[, event := factor(event, levels = names(EV_PAL))]
p3c <- ggplot(T3e, aes(event, rmse, fill = event)) + geom_col(width = 0.6) + facet_wrap(~sensor) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f m\n(%s pairs)", rmse, fmt(n))), vjust = -0.2, size = 2.7, colour = "grey15", lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = EV_PAL, guide = "none") + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RMSE (m)", title = "c  All delays: pairs with and without a disturbance in between") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
save((p3a / p3b / p3c) + plot_layout(heights = c(1.25, 1, 0.8)) + plot_annotation(
  title = "How much the delay between the ALS and the satellite costs",
  subtitle = sprintf("Samples within %d m of the plot centre at every delay: ALS 2009–2025, satellites June–September 2019–2025.", DELAY_R),
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))), "P3_delay_uncertainty.png", 12, 10.5)

###############################################################################
# P4 Forest type and ALS season
###############################################################################
cat("figure P4\n")
GAP4 <- 3
ft_tab <- function(d, sen) d[!is.na(forest_type), {
  b1 <- boot_plot(.SD, function(x) mean(x$sat - x$als)); b2 <- boot_plot(.SD, function(x) rmse(x$sat - x$als))
  .(bias = mean(sat - als), bias_lo = b1[1], bias_hi = b1[2], rmse = rmse(sat - als), rmse_lo = b2[1], rmse_hi = b2[2],
    bias50 = if (sen == "GEDI L2A") mean(rh50 - zq50) else NA_real_, n = .N, plots = uniqueN(plot_id)) },
  by = .(forest_type, als_season)][, sensor := sen][]
T4 <- rbind(ft_tab(G[on_plot == TRUE & abs(gap) <= GAP4 & event == "No MRNF event"], "GEDI L2A"),
            ft_tab(A[on_plot == TRUE & abs(gap) <= GAP4 & event == "No MRNF event"], "ICESat-2 ATL08"))[n >= 20]
T4[, sensor := factor(sensor, levels = names(SENSOR))]
fwrite(T4, file.path(OUTP, "table_by_forest_type_and_als_season.csv"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(T4))) with(T4[i], say("Forest %s | %s | %s: n=%d plots=%d bias=%+.2f RMSE=%.2f RH50-zq50=%+.2f",
                                              sensor, forest_type, als_season, n, plots, bias, rmse, bias50))
M_B <- "Mean difference, satellite − ALS (m)"; M_R <- "RMSE (m)"
T4l <- rbind(T4[, .(sensor, forest_type, als_season, n, stat = M_B, est = bias, lo = bias_lo, hi = bias_hi)],
             T4[, .(sensor, forest_type, als_season, n, stat = M_R, est = rmse, lo = rmse_lo, hi = rmse_hi)])
T4l[, stat := factor(stat, levels = c(M_B, M_R))]
p4 <- ggplot(T4l, aes(forest_type, est, colour = als_season, group = als_season)) +
  geom_hline(data = data.frame(stat = factor(M_B, levels = c(M_B, M_R)), y = 0), aes(yintercept = y), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, position = position_dodge(0.5)) +
  geom_text(aes(y = hi, label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 2.3, colour = INK2, position = position_dodge(0.5), show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(stat ~ sensor, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") + scale_colour_manual(values = SEASON_PAL, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Forest type of the plot (field tree tally)", y = NULL, title = "Agreement by forest type and by the season the ALS was flown",
       subtitle = sprintf("Samples on the plot, delay ≤ %d years, no MRNF event in between. Numbers = pairs; 95%% intervals: bootstrap over plots.\nThe satellites are always leaf-on (June–September).", GAP4)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.placement = "outside")
if (nrow(T4)) save(p4, "P4_forest_type_and_als_season.png", 11, 7.5)
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(OUTP, "sessionInfo.txt"))
cat("Done. Numbers in", NUM, "\n")
check_step(8)

# Steps 9–11. Why? The same ground, footprint by footprint

In one region (UPE 14–15, `data/study_area/`), the ALS is cut to the exact ground of each satellite sample. Page 6
of the tutorial explains the results. With `run_why = false`, steps 9 and 10 are skipped and step 11 uses the
tables provided in `data/why/`. With `run_why = true`, step 2 needs `data/derived/plot_tiles.csv` from step 1
for the tile URLs.

## Step 9. Satellite samples inside the region's ALS tiles

The tiles that hold the region's plots:

```{py step9-tiles, ref.label = "step9", echo = FALSE, eval = params$run_why, args = "--tiles-only"}
```

All the satellite samples of the region (not only near the plots: every sample inside a tile counts):

```{py step9-gedi, ref.label = "get-spaceborne-lidar", echo = FALSE, eval = params$run_why, args = c("data/study_area/upe1415_study_area.shp", "--product", "gedi02a", "--years", "2019-2025", "--months", "6-9", "--out", "data/derived/why/gedi02a.parquet")}
```

```{py step9-atl08, ref.label = "get-spaceborne-lidar", echo = FALSE, eval = params$run_why, args = c("data/study_area/upe1415_study_area.shp", "--product", "atl08", "--years", "2019-2025", "--months", "6-9", "--out", "data/derived/why/atl08.parquet")}
```

The 306 LAZ tiles, with the code of step 2 restricted to the list:

```{r step9-laz-list, eval = params$run_why}
Sys.setenv(TILE_LIST = "data/derived/why/tiles_needed.csv")
```

```{r step9-laz, ref.label = "step2", echo = FALSE, eval = params$run_why}
```

```{r step9-laz-done, eval = params$run_why}
Sys.unsetenv("TILE_LIST")
```

Then the samples inside the tiles, their nearest plot and the MRNF events after the flight (the chunks above ran
it first with `--tiles-only`):

```{py step9, eval = params$run_why}
"""
09_footprint_inputs.py - inputs for checking ICESat-2 / GEDI against airborne lidar (ALS) on the exact ground of
each satellite sample, in one region: the UPE 14-15 study area (data/study_area/, 12,644 km2, ALS 2017-2018).

Author:    João Paulo Czarnecki de Liz (developer)
Co-author: Claude (Anthropic), AI coding assistant
Licence:   MIT (see LICENSE)

Two passes:
  --tiles-only  lists the ALS tiles that hold the region's plots (data/derived/why/tiles_needed.csv), to download
                them with   TILE_LIST=data/derived/why/tiles_needed.csv Rscript scripts/02_download_laz.R
  (default)     once the tiles are on disk, builds the tables below.

What it builds (all in data/derived/why/):
  plots_upe.csv      one row per PEP plot inside the study area that has ALS metrics: plot ALS metrics
                     (data/plot_als_metrics.csv, 11.28 m plots), ALS tile and acquisition date, forest type
                     from the field tree tally closest to the satellite years, field top height, and MRNF
                     disturbances recorded after the ALS flight.
  tiles_upe.csv      the 1 km ALS tiles that hold those plots (path, EPSG, extent, acquisition dates).
  samples_gedi.csv   every downloaded GEDI L2A shot whose 25 m footprint lies wholly inside one of those tiles,
                     with the footprint centre in the tile CRS, nearest plot and post-ALS disturbance flags.
                     No quality filters applied here (leaf-off, sensitivity), so their effect can be tested.
  samples_atl08.csv  same for ICESat-2 ATL08 100 m segments (all beams, snow flag kept), with the along-track
                     direction so the 100 m x 14 m segment rectangle can be drawn in the tile CRS.
  mrnf_cache/        MRNF harvest / fire / other-disturbance polygons per tile (public WFS, cached).

Forest type (MFFP convention, live basal area of trees >= 9.1 cm dbh): R softwood >= 75 %, F hardwood >= 75 %,
M mixed otherwise; "Open / regenerating" when live basal area < 4 m2/ha.

Inputs (read-only)
  data/study_area/upe1415_study_area.shp       the region (provided)
  data/raw/PEP.gpkg                            PEP plots and tree tally (Données Québec; or set PEP_GPKG)
  data/plot_als_metrics.csv                    plot ALS metrics and tile names (provided; or your own
                                               data/derived/plot_als_metrics_full.csv from step 3)
  data/plot_mrnf_events.csv                    MRNF events under each plot (provided; or yours from step 6)
  data/derived/why/{gedi02a,atl08}.csv         satellite samples over the region, all of them, from
                                               05_get_spaceborne_lidar.py with the study area as polygon
  data/raw/laz/*.LAZ                           the region's ALS tiles (only their headers are read here)
  MRNF WFS                                     disturbance polygons per tile (public; cached in mrnf_cache/)

Run   python -I scripts/09_footprint_inputs.py --tiles-only      (seconds)
      python -I scripts/09_footprint_inputs.py                   (~10 min the first time, WFS cached after)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import struct
import sys
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import warnings

import geopandas as gpd
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pyproj import Transformer
from shapely.geometry import Point, Polygon, shape

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
ROOT = os.environ.get("EXERCISE_ROOT", ".")
OUT = os.environ.get("WHY_DIR", os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "derived", "why"))
DAT = os.environ.get("WHY_SAT_DIR", OUT)                 # where gedi02a.csv and atl08.csv of the region are
os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "mrnf_cache"), exist_ok=True)

PEP = os.environ.get("PEP_GPKG", os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "raw", "PEP.gpkg"))
LAZ = os.environ.get("LAZ_DIR", os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "raw", "laz"))
AREA = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "study_area", "upe1415_study_area.shp")
_own = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "derived", "plot_als_metrics_full.csv")
ALS_TABLE = _own if os.path.exists(_own) else os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "plot_als_metrics.csv")
_ev = os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "derived", "plot_mrnf_events.csv")
EVENTS = _ev if os.path.exists(_ev) else os.path.join(ROOT, "data", "plot_mrnf_events.csv")
TILES_ONLY = "--tiles-only" in sys.argv
WFS = "https://geoegl.msp.gouv.qc.ca/ws/mffpecofor.fcgi"
LAYERS = ["ca_interv_for_close_scale", "ca_feu_close_scale", "ca_perturb_autre_close_scale"]

GEDI_R = 12.5            # GEDI footprint radius (m)
SEG_HALF_L, SEG_HALF_W = 50.0, 7.0   # ATL08 segment: 100 m along track x ~14 m (footprint width)
SOFTWOOD = {"SAB", "EPN", "EPB", "EPR", "EPO", "PIG", "PIB", "PIR", "PIS", "PRU", "THO", "MEL", "MEH", "MEJ", "MEU"}
LIVE = {"10", "12", "30", "32", "40", "42", "50", "52"}   # PEP etat codes for live trees
ALS_METRICS = ["pt_density_m2", "zmax", "zmean", "zq25", "zq50", "zq75", "zq90", "zq95", "pzabove2", "pzabove5",
               "canopy_cover_2m_fr", "p_overstory_10plus", "zsd"]


def log(*a):
    print(*a, flush=True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- plots in the study area -------------------
area = gpd.read_file(AREA).to_crs(2950)              # NAD83(CSRS) / Quebec Lambert
pl = gpd.read_file(PEP, layer="placette").to_crs(area.crs)
pl = gpd.sjoin(pl, area[["geometry"]], predicate="within").drop(columns="index_right")
pl["plot_id"] = pl.id_pe.astype(np.int64)
als = pd.read_csv(ALS_TABLE)
if "status" in als.columns:
    als = als[als.status == "ok"]
als = als[als.plot_id.isin(pl.plot_id)].copy()
if "tile_file_name" not in als.columns:
    als["tile_file_name"] = als.NOM_TUILE + ".LAZ"
metrics = [m for m in ALS_METRICS if m in als.columns]
plots = pl[["plot_id", "id_pe", "geometry"]].merge(
    als[["plot_id", "latitude", "longitude", "CODE_EPSG", "DATES_ACQUISITION", "tile_file_name"] + metrics], on="plot_id")
plots["x2950"], plots["y2950"] = plots.geometry.x, plots.geometry.y
plots["als_date"] = plots.DATES_ACQUISITION.str.split(",").str[0]
plots["als_date_last"] = plots.DATES_ACQUISITION.str.split(",").str[-1]
log(f"{len(pl)} PEP plots in the area, {len(plots)} with ALS metrics ({ALS_TABLE})")
if TILES_ONLY:
    need = plots[["tile_file_name"]].drop_duplicates()
    need.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "tiles_needed.csv"), index=False)
    log(f"{len(need)} tiles listed in {os.path.join(OUT, 'tiles_needed.csv')}")
    sys.exit(0)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- field: forest type + top height ----------
con = sqlite3.connect(PEP)
ids = "','".join(plots.id_pe)
mes = pd.read_sql(f"select id_pe, id_pe_mes, no_mes, date_sond from placette_mes where id_pe in ('{ids}')", con)
mes["field_year"] = mes.date_sond.str[:4].astype(int)
# measurement closest to the satellite years: the latest one from 2015 on, else the latest available
mes = mes.sort_values(["id_pe", "no_mes"])
pick = mes[mes.field_year >= 2015].groupby("id_pe").tail(1)
pick = pd.concat([pick, mes[~mes.id_pe.isin(pick.id_pe)].groupby("id_pe").tail(1)])
tr = pd.read_sql(f"select id_pe_mes, etat, essence, dhp, st_ha from dendro_arbres where id_pe in ('{ids}')", con)
tr = tr[tr.id_pe_mes.isin(pick.id_pe_mes) & tr.etat.isin(LIVE)]
tr["soft"] = tr.essence.isin(SOFTWOOD)
ba = tr.groupby("id_pe_mes").agg(ba_live=("st_ha", "sum"), n_live=("st_ha", "size"))
ba["ba_soft"] = tr[tr.soft].groupby("id_pe_mes").st_ha.sum()
ba["ba_soft"] = ba.ba_soft.fillna(0)
dom = tr.groupby(["id_pe_mes", "essence"]).st_ha.sum().reset_index().sort_values("st_ha") \
    .groupby("id_pe_mes").tail(1).set_index("id_pe_mes").essence
ba["dom_species"] = dom
ba["soft_share"] = ba.ba_soft / ba.ba_live
et = pd.read_sql(f"select id_pe_mes, etat, haut_arbre from dendro_arbres_etudes where id_pe in ('{ids}')", con)
et = et[et.id_pe_mes.isin(pick.id_pe_mes) & et.etat.isin(LIVE) & et.haut_arbre.notna()]
et["h"] = et.haut_arbre / 10.0                                   # decimetres -> m
top = et.sort_values("h").groupby("id_pe_mes").h.apply(lambda v: v.tail(3).mean()).rename("field_htop")
hmax = et.groupby("id_pe_mes").h.max().rename("field_hmax")
nh = et.groupby("id_pe_mes").h.size().rename("field_n_heights")
fld = pick.set_index("id_pe_mes").join([ba, top, hmax, nh]).reset_index()


def ftype(r):
    if pd.isna(r.ba_live) or r.ba_live < 4:
        return "Open / regenerating"
    if r.soft_share >= 0.75:
        return "Softwood"
    if r.soft_share <= 0.25:
        return "Hardwood"
    return "Mixed"


fld["forest_type"] = fld.apply(ftype, axis=1)
plots = plots.merge(fld[["id_pe", "field_year", "no_mes", "ba_live", "soft_share", "dom_species", "forest_type",
                         "field_htop", "field_hmax", "field_n_heights"]], on="id_pe", how="left")
log(plots.forest_type.value_counts().to_dict())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- disturbance after the ALS flight ----------
ev = pd.read_csv(EVENTS)
ev = ev[ev.plot_id.isin(plots.plot_id) & (ev.overlap >= 0.5)].copy()
ev["year"] = ev.an_perturb.fillna(ev.an_origine).fillna(ev.exercice)
ev = ev.merge(plots[["plot_id", "als_date"]], on="plot_id")
ev = ev[ev.year >= ev.als_date.str[:4].astype(int)]          # same year counted: it may postdate the flight
ev["kind"] = np.where(ev.layer == "ca_feu_close_scale", "fire",
                      np.where(ev.layer == "ca_interv_for_close_scale",
                               np.where(ev.origine.notna(), "harvest (stand-replacing)", "partial cut / tending"),
                               "other natural"))
post = ev.groupby("plot_id").agg(post_als_event=("kind", lambda k: "; ".join(sorted(set(k)))),
                                 post_als_year=("year", "min"))
plots = plots.merge(post, on="plot_id", how="left")
plots["post_als_event"] = plots.post_als_event.fillna("none")
log("plots disturbed after ALS:", (plots.post_als_event != "none").sum())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- tiles ------------------------------------
def las_header(path):
    """Point count and extent from the LAS/LAZ public header (the header of a LAZ file is not compressed)."""
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        h = fh.read(255)
    minor = h[25]
    n = struct.unpack("<I", h[107:111])[0]
    if minor >= 4 and n == 0:
        n = struct.unpack("<Q", h[247:255])[0]
    xmax, xmin, ymax, ymin = struct.unpack("<4d", h[179:211])
    return n, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax


tiles = plots[["tile_file_name", "CODE_EPSG", "DATES_ACQUISITION"]].drop_duplicates("tile_file_name").copy()
tiles["path"] = [os.path.abspath(os.path.join(LAZ, f)) for f in tiles.tile_file_name]
missing = int((~tiles.path.map(os.path.exists)).sum())
if missing:
    log(f"WARNING: {missing} of {len(tiles)} tiles are not in {LAZ}; their plots and samples are left out")
tiles = tiles[tiles.path.map(os.path.exists)].copy()
hdr = [las_header(p) for p in tiles.path]
for k, c in enumerate(["hdr_npoints", "hdr_xmin", "hdr_xmax", "hdr_ymin", "hdr_ymax"]):
    tiles[c] = [h[k] for h in hdr]
tiles["empirical_density_pts_m2"] = tiles.hdr_npoints / ((tiles.hdr_xmax - tiles.hdr_xmin) * (tiles.hdr_ymax - tiles.hdr_ymin))
plots = plots[plots.tile_file_name.isin(tiles.tile_file_name)]
tiles["als_date"] = tiles.DATES_ACQUISITION.str.split(",").str[0]
log(f"{len(tiles)} tiles, {tiles.hdr_npoints.sum() / 1e9:.2f} G points")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- satellite samples inside tiles -----------
TR = {e: Transformer.from_crs(4326, int(e), always_xy=True) for e in tiles.CODE_EPSG.unique()}


def to_tile_xy(d, epsg):
    return TR[epsg].transform(d.lon.values, d.lat.values)


def assign(d, kind):
    """Return the rows of d whose whole footprint lies inside a tile, with tile id and tile-CRS coordinates."""
    out = []
    for epsg, tg in tiles.groupby("CODE_EPSG"):
        x, y = to_tile_xy(d, epsg)
        dd = d.assign(x_tile=x, y_tile=y)
        if kind == "atl08":
            ux, uy = dd[f"ux_{epsg}"].values, dd[f"uy_{epsg}"].values
            # half-extent of the rotated rectangle along x and y
            ex = np.abs(ux) * SEG_HALF_L + np.abs(uy) * SEG_HALF_W
            ey = np.abs(uy) * SEG_HALF_L + np.abs(ux) * SEG_HALF_W
        else:
            ex = ey = np.full(len(dd), GEDI_R)
        for t in tg.itertuples():
            m = (x - ex >= t.hdr_xmin + 1) & (x + ex <= t.hdr_xmax - 1) & (y - ey >= t.hdr_ymin + 1) & (y + ey <= t.hdr_ymax - 1)
            if m.any():
                s = dd[m].copy()
                s["tile_file_name"], s["tile_epsg"] = t.tile_file_name, int(epsg)
                if kind == "atl08":
                    s["ux"], s["uy"] = s[f"ux_{epsg}"], s[f"uy_{epsg}"]
                out.append(s)
    r = pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)
    return r.drop(columns=[c for c in r.columns if c.startswith(("ux_", "uy_"))])


# GEDI L2A, no filters
g = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DAT, "gedi02a.csv"))
g = g[(g.lon > -80) & (g.lat > 44)]
gs = assign(g, "gedi")
log(f"GEDI L2A shots inside tiles: {len(gs)} (of {len(g)})")

# ATL08: along-track direction from neighbouring segments of the same beam and date, in each tile CRS
a = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DAT, "atl08.csv"))
a["date"] = a.time_ns.str[:10]
a = a.sort_values(["rgt", "cycle", "gt", "date", "segment_id_beg"]).reset_index(drop=True)
for epsg in tiles.CODE_EPSG.unique():
    x, y = to_tile_xy(a, epsg)
    a["_x"], a["_y"] = x, y
    grp = a.groupby(["rgt", "cycle", "gt", "date"])
    dx = grp._x.shift(-1) - grp._x.shift(1)
    dy = grp._y.shift(-1) - grp._y.shift(1)
    dx = dx.fillna(grp._x.shift(-1) - a._x).fillna(a._x - grp._x.shift(1))
    dy = dy.fillna(grp._y.shift(-1) - a._y).fillna(a._y - grp._y.shift(1))
    L = np.hypot(dx, dy)
    ok = (L > 0) & (L < 500)                         # neighbours more than 500 m away are another stretch
    a[f"ux_{epsg}"] = np.where(ok, dx / L, np.nan)
    a[f"uy_{epsg}"] = np.where(ok, dy / L, np.nan)
    # isolated segments: use the median direction of their beam on that date
    for c in (f"ux_{epsg}", f"uy_{epsg}"):
        a[c] = a[c].fillna(a.groupby(["rgt", "cycle", "gt", "date"])[c].transform("median"))
a = a.drop(columns=["_x", "_y"])
a = a[a[[c for c in a.columns if c.startswith("ux_")]].notna().all(axis=1)]
as_ = assign(a, "atl08")
log(f"ATL08 segments inside tiles: {len(as_)} (of {len(a)})")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- nearest plot -----------------------------
t2950 = Transformer.from_crs(4326, 2950, always_xy=True)
pp = gpd.GeoDataFrame(plots[["plot_id", "forest_type"]], geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(plots.x2950, plots.y2950), crs=2950)
for s in (gs, as_):
    x, y = t2950.transform(s.lon.values, s.lat.values)
    s["x2950"], s["y2950"] = x, y
    sp = gpd.GeoDataFrame({"row": np.arange(len(s))}, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(x, y), crs=2950)
    nn = gpd.sjoin_nearest(sp, pp, distance_col="d").drop_duplicates("row").sort_values("row")
    s["near_plot"], s["near_plot_dist"] = nn.plot_id.values, nn.d.values
    s["near_forest_type"] = nn.forest_type.values


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- MRNF disturbance polygons per tile --------
def wfs_tile(t):
    """Harvest / fire / other polygons intersecting the tile (EPSG:4326 bbox), cached as GeoJSON."""
    path = os.path.join(OUT, "mrnf_cache", t.tile_file_name.replace(".LAZ", ".json"))
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            return json.load(fh)
    inv = Transformer.from_crs(int(t.CODE_EPSG), 4326, always_xy=True)
    lo, la = inv.transform([t.hdr_xmin, t.hdr_xmax, t.hdr_xmin, t.hdr_xmax], [t.hdr_ymin, t.hdr_ymin, t.hdr_ymax, t.hdr_ymax])
    feats = []
    for layer in LAYERS:
        q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"service": "WFS", "version": "2.0.0", "request": "GetFeature",
                                    "typeNames": f"ms:{layer}", "outputFormat": "geojson",
                                    "bbox": f"{min(la)},{min(lo)},{max(la)},{max(lo)},urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326"})
        for attempt in range(4):
            try:
                with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{WFS}?{q}", timeout=120) as r:
                    js = json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
                break
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                if attempt == 3:
                    raise
                time.sleep(5 * (attempt + 1))
        for f in js.get("features", []):
            f["properties"]["layer"] = layer
            feats.append(f)
    out = {"type": "FeatureCollection", "features": feats}
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(out, fh)
    return out


log("MRNF disturbance polygons per tile (cached after the first run)...")
polys = []
for i, t in enumerate(tiles.itertuples()):
    js = wfs_tile(t)
    for f in js["features"]:
        p = f["properties"]
        yr = p.get("an_perturb") or p.get("an_origine") or p.get("exercice")
        try:
            yr = int(float(yr))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
        geom = shape(f["geometry"])
        if not geom.is_valid:
            geom = geom.buffer(0)
        kind = ("fire" if p["layer"] == "ca_feu_close_scale" else
                ("harvest (stand-replacing)" if p.get("origine") else "partial cut / tending")
                if p["layer"] == "ca_interv_for_close_scale" else "other natural")
        polys.append({"year": yr, "kind": kind, "code": p.get("origine") or p.get("perturb"), "geometry": geom})
    if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
        log(f"  {i + 1}/{len(tiles)} tiles")
dist = gpd.GeoDataFrame(polys, crs=4326).to_crs(2950) if polys else gpd.GeoDataFrame(columns=["year", "kind", "geometry"], crs=2950)
dist = dist[dist.year >= tiles.als_date.str[:4].astype(int).min() - 1]   # only what can postdate the flights matters
dist.to_file(os.path.join(OUT, "mrnf_disturbance_after_als.gpkg"), driver="GPKG")
log(f"{len(dist)} MRNF polygons dated from the year before the first flight on")


def flag_post_als(s, kind):
    """Earliest MRNF event (year >= ALS year) intersecting each footprint."""
    if kind == "gedi":
        geo = gpd.GeoSeries(gpd.points_from_xy(s.x2950, s.y2950), crs=2950).buffer(GEDI_R)
    else:  # rectangle in EPSG:2950 (direction from the tile CRS; the rotation between MTM 8 and 9 is < 1 degree)
        ux, uy = s.ux.values, s.uy.values
        cx, cy = s.x2950.values, s.y2950.values
        geo = gpd.GeoSeries([Polygon([(x - SEG_HALF_L * a_ - SEG_HALF_W * b_, y - SEG_HALF_L * b_ + SEG_HALF_W * a_),
                                      (x + SEG_HALF_L * a_ - SEG_HALF_W * b_, y + SEG_HALF_L * b_ + SEG_HALF_W * a_),
                                      (x + SEG_HALF_L * a_ + SEG_HALF_W * b_, y + SEG_HALF_L * b_ - SEG_HALF_W * a_),
                                      (x - SEG_HALF_L * a_ + SEG_HALF_W * b_, y - SEG_HALF_L * b_ - SEG_HALF_W * a_)])
                             for x, y, a_, b_ in zip(cx, cy, ux, uy)], crs=2950)
    fp = gpd.GeoDataFrame({"row": np.arange(len(s))}, geometry=geo.values, crs=2950)
    als_year = s.tile_file_name.map(tiles.set_index("tile_file_name").als_date.str[:4].astype(int)).values
    j = gpd.sjoin(fp, dist[["year", "kind", "geometry"]], predicate="intersects")
    j = j[j.year.values >= als_year[j.row.values]]
    first = j.sort_values(["year", "kind"], kind="stable").groupby("row").first()   # same year: fire, then harvest, then the rest
    s["post_als_event"] = "none"
    s.loc[s.index[first.index], "post_als_event"] = first.kind.values
    s["post_als_year"] = np.nan
    s.loc[s.index[first.index], "post_als_year"] = first.year.values
    return s


gs = flag_post_als(gs.reset_index(drop=True), "gedi")
as_ = flag_post_als(as_.reset_index(drop=True), "atl08")
log("GEDI post-ALS:", gs.post_als_event.value_counts().to_dict())
log("ATL08 post-ALS:", as_.post_als_event.value_counts().to_dict())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- write ------------------------------------
plots.drop(columns="geometry").to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "plots_upe.csv"), index=False)
plots[["plot_id", "forest_type", "geometry"]].to_file(os.path.join(OUT, "plots_upe.gpkg"), driver="GPKG")
tiles.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "tiles_upe.csv"), index=False)
gs.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "samples_gedi.csv"), index=False)
as_.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "samples_atl08.csv"), index=False)
log("wrote", OUT)
```

check_step(9)
```

## Step 10. ALS on the ground of each footprint

```{r step10, eval = params$run_why}
###############################################################################
# 10_als_at_footprints.R - airborne lidar (ALS) equivalents of the ICESat-2 and GEDI metrics, computed on the
# exact ground each satellite sample covers, in the ALS tiles that hold the PEP plots of the UPE 14-15 region.
#
# Author:    João Paulo Czarnecki de Liz (developer)
# Co-author: Claude (Anthropic), AI coding assistant
# Licence:   MIT (see LICENSE)
#
# For every tile: read the LAZ (provider classification: 2 = ground), normalise heights with a TIN of the
# ground returns, floor heights at 0 and drop returns above 60 m, then clip
#   * each GEDI footprint: circle of 12.5 m radius around the shot centre
#   * each ATL08 segment:  rectangle 100 m along track x 14 m across, centred on the segment
#   * each PEP plot:       circle of 11.28 m (check against data/plot_als_metrics.csv, which used CSF ground)
# and compute the ALS version of each satellite metric:
#   GEDI RHxx      <-> ALS percentile xx of ALL return heights (ground included; RH is relative to the ground
#                      return, like the ALS heights) - als_rh10 ... als_rh100
#   ATL08 h_canopy <-> ALS 98th percentile of CANOPY returns (> 0.5 m, where ATL08 starts calling photons canopy),
#                      als_p98_can; ch_p50 <-> als_p50_can; h_mean_canopy <-> als_mean_can; same with > 2 m in
#                      als_*_can2; segment with no canopy photons <-> fewer than 3 canopy returns
#   cover          <-> ALS first returns > 2 m / all first returns (als_cover2); > 5 m (als_cover5)
#
# Input   data/derived/why/tiles_upe.csv, samples_gedi.csv, samples_atl08.csv, plots_upe.csv (09_footprint_inputs.py)
# Output  data/derived/why/als_at_gedi.csv, als_at_atl08.csv, als_at_plots_check.csv, als_tile_wall_to_wall.csv
#         (1 m CHM summary per tile) and als_cache/<tile>_chm_dm.tif (the CHM, in decimetres)
# Run     WORKERS=6 Rscript scripts/10_als_at_footprints.R           (~4.5 h for 306 tiles, 23.5 GB of LAZ;
#         one cache file per tile, so it resumes after a stop)
#         TILE_LIMIT=3 Rscript scripts/10_als_at_footprints.R        (a quick try on 3 tiles)
###############################################################################
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(lidR); library(data.table); library(parallel) })
ROOT <- Sys.getenv("EXERCISE_ROOT", ".")
WORKERS <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("WORKERS", "6"))
NTILES  <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("TILE_LIMIT", "0")); if (NTILES <= 0) NTILES <- Inf
OUT <- Sys.getenv("WHY_DIR", file.path(ROOT, "data/derived/why"))
CACHE <- Sys.getenv("WHY_CACHE", file.path(OUT, "als_cache")); dir.create(CACHE, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

tiles <- fread(file.path(OUT, "tiles_upe.csv"))
gedi  <- fread(file.path(OUT, "samples_gedi.csv"),  select = c("time", "beam", "tile_file_name", "x_tile", "y_tile"), colClasses = list(character = "time"))
atl   <- fread(file.path(OUT, "samples_atl08.csv"), select = c("time_ns", "rgt", "cycle", "gt", "segment_id_beg",
                                                               "tile_file_name", "x_tile", "y_tile", "ux", "uy"), colClasses = list(character = "time_ns"))
plots <- fread(file.path(OUT, "plots_upe.csv"), select = c("plot_id", "tile_file_name", "latitude", "longitude",
                                                           "CODE_EPSG"))
tiles <- tiles[order(-(tile_file_name %in% c(gedi$tile_file_name, atl$tile_file_name)))]
if (is.finite(NTILES)) tiles <- tiles[seq_len(min(NTILES, .N))]

one_tile <- function(t, gedi, atl, plots, CACHE) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(lidR); library(data.table); library(sf) })
  set_lidr_threads(1L); options(lidR.progress = FALSE)
  f <- file.path(CACHE, sub("\\.LAZ$", ".rds", t$tile_file_name))
  if (file.exists(f) && identical(readRDS(f)$version, 2L)) return(f)   # reuse caches of this version only
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  g <- gedi[tile_file_name == t$tile_file_name]; a <- atl[tile_file_name == t$tile_file_name]
  p <- plots[tile_file_name == t$tile_file_name]
  las <- readLAS(t$path, select = "xyzrnc", filter = "-drop_withheld -drop_class 7 18")
  res <- list(tile = t$tile_file_name, version = 2L, status = "ok", gedi = NULL, atl = NULL, plots = NULL)
  if (is.empty(las) || sum(las$Classification == 2L) < 100) {
    res$status <- "no_ground"; saveRDS(res, f); return(f)
  }
  las <- normalize_height(las, tin(), use_class = 2L)
  las <- filter_poi(las, Z >= -2, Z <= 60)
  las$Z[las$Z < 0] <- 0
  # GEDI-like metrics: percentiles of all returns, first-return cover
  mg <- function(z, rn) {
    q <- quantile(z, c(.10, .25, .50, .75, .90, .95, .98, 1), names = FALSE)
    fr <- z[rn == 1L]
    list(als_n = length(z), als_rh10 = q[1], als_rh25 = q[2], als_rh50 = q[3], als_rh75 = q[4], als_rh90 = q[5],
         als_rh95 = q[6], als_rh98 = q[7], als_rh100 = q[8],
         als_cover2 = if (length(fr)) mean(fr > 2) else NA_real_, als_cover5 = if (length(fr)) mean(fr > 5) else NA_real_,
         als_frac2 = mean(z > 2))
  }
  # ATL08-like metrics: percentiles of canopy returns. ATL08 labels photons from ~0.5 m above the ground as
  # canopy (median h_min_canopy 0.64 m here), so returns > 0.5 m are the main counterpart; > 2 m kept to compare
  ma <- function(z, rn) {
    fr <- z[rn == 1L]
    can <- function(thr, sfx) {
      cz <- z[z > thr]
      qc <- if (length(cz) >= 3) quantile(cz, c(.25, .50, .75, .98), names = FALSE) else rep(NA_real_, 4)
      setNames(list(length(cz), qc[1], qc[2], qc[3], qc[4], if (length(cz) >= 3) mean(cz) else NA_real_),
               paste0(c("als_n_can", "als_p25_can", "als_p50_can", "als_p75_can", "als_p98_can", "als_mean_can"), sfx))
    }
    c(list(als_n = length(z)), can(0.5, ""), can(2, "2"),
      list(als_max = max(z), als_p98_all = quantile(z, .98, names = FALSE),
           als_cover2 = if (length(fr)) mean(fr > 2) else NA_real_, als_cover5 = if (length(fr)) mean(fr > 5) else NA_real_,
           als_frac2 = mean(z > 2)))
  }
  run_clips <- function(clips, fun) rbindlist(lapply(clips, function(l) {
    if (is.null(l) || is.empty(l)) return(data.table(als_n = 0L)) else as.data.table(fun(l$Z, l$ReturnNumber))
  }), fill = TRUE)
  if (nrow(g)) {
    cl <- clip_circle(las, g$x_tile, g$y_tile, 12.5)
    if (inherits(cl, "LAS")) cl <- list(cl)
    res$gedi <- cbind(g[, .(time, beam)], run_clips(cl, mg))
  }
  if (nrow(a)) {
    rect <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(a)), function(i) {
      cx <- a$x_tile[i]; cy <- a$y_tile[i]; ux <- a$ux[i]; uy <- a$uy[i]; L <- 50; W <- 7
      m <- rbind(c(cx - L * ux - W * uy, cy - L * uy + W * ux), c(cx + L * ux - W * uy, cy + L * uy + W * ux),
                 c(cx + L * ux + W * uy, cy + L * uy - W * ux), c(cx - L * ux + W * uy, cy - L * uy - W * ux))
      st_polygon(list(rbind(m, m[1, ])))
    })
    cl <- clip_roi(las, st_sfc(rect, crs = st_crs(las)))
    if (inherits(cl, "LAS")) cl <- list(cl)
    res$atl <- cbind(a[, .(time_ns, rgt, cycle, gt, segment_id_beg)], run_clips(cl, ma))
  }
  if (nrow(p)) {
    xy <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(p, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326), st_crs(las)))
    cl <- clip_circle(las, xy[, 1], xy[, 2], 11.28)
    if (inherits(cl, "LAS")) cl <- list(cl)
    res$plots <- cbind(p[, .(plot_id)], run_clips(cl, mg))
  }
  # wall-to-wall reference for the tile: 1 m canopy height model (highest return per cell) and first returns
  chm <- rasterize_canopy(las, res = 1, algorithm = p2r(0.2))
  v <- terra::values(chm, mat = FALSE); v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  fr <- las$Z[las$ReturnNumber == 1L]
  res$tile_stats <- data.table(chm_cells = length(v), chm_cover2 = mean(v > 2), chm_cover5 = mean(v > 5),
                               chm_med_can = median(v[v > 2]), chm_p90_can = quantile(v[v > 2], 0.9, names = FALSE),
                               fr_cover2 = mean(fr > 2), fr_cover5 = mean(fr > 5), n_points = npoints(las))
  terra::writeRaster(round(chm * 10), file.path(CACHE, sub("\\.LAZ$", "_chm_dm.tif", t$tile_file_name)),
                     datatype = "INT2U", gdal = c("COMPRESS=DEFLATE"), overwrite = TRUE)
  res$seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  saveRDS(res, f); rm(las); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  f
}

cat(sprintf("%d tiles, %d GEDI shots, %d ATL08 segments, %d plots; %d workers\n",
            nrow(tiles), nrow(gedi), nrow(atl), nrow(plots), WORKERS))
tl <- split(tiles, seq_len(nrow(tiles)))
t_start <- Sys.time()
if (WORKERS > 1) {
  cl <- makeCluster(WORKERS)
  files <- parLapplyLB(cl, tl, one_tile, gedi = gedi, atl = atl, plots = plots, CACHE = CACHE)
  stopCluster(cl)
} else files <- lapply(tl, one_tile, gedi = gedi, atl = atl, plots = plots, CACHE = CACHE)
cat(sprintf("extraction: %.1f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))))

R <- lapply(unlist(files), readRDS)
cat("tile status:", paste(names(table(sapply(R, `[[`, "status"))), table(sapply(R, `[[`, "status")), collapse = " "),
    "| median s per tile:", round(median(unlist(lapply(R, `[[`, "seconds")), na.rm = TRUE), 1), "\n")
bind <- function(k) rbindlist(lapply(R, function(r) if (!is.null(r[[k]])) cbind(tile_file_name = r$tile, r[[k]])), fill = TRUE)
fwrite(bind("gedi"),  file.path(OUT, "als_at_gedi.csv"))
fwrite(bind("atl"),   file.path(OUT, "als_at_atl08.csv"))
fwrite(bind("plots"), file.path(OUT, "als_at_plots_check.csv"))
fwrite(bind("tile_stats"), file.path(OUT, "als_tile_wall_to_wall.csv"))
cat("wrote als_at_gedi.csv, als_at_atl08.csv, als_at_plots_check.csv, als_tile_wall_to_wall.csv\n")
```

## Step 11. Comparison and figures

```{r step11}
###############################################################################
# 11_footprint_figures.R - ICESat-2 and GEDI against airborne lidar (ALS) on the same ground, in the UPE 14-15
# region: the "why" behind the plot-level results of steps 5-6 (docs/06_why_on_the_same_ground.md).
#
# Author:    João Paulo Czarnecki de Liz (developer)
# Co-author: Claude (Anthropic), AI coding assistant
# Licence:   MIT (see LICENSE)
#
# Three levels of comparison, from the most to the least like-for-like:
#   footprint  satellite metric vs the ALS version of the same metric on the same ground (10_als_at_footprints.R)
#   plot       ALS metrics of the 400 m2 PEP plot (data/plot_als_metrics.csv) vs satellite samples within r m
#   tile       polygon metrics (cover_tall, h_med) for the ALS tiles vs the same from ALS, and vs the wall-to-wall
#              ALS canopy height model
# Periods: ALS flown in 2017 (1 Aug-1 Oct, leaf-on) and 2018 (30 May-12 Jun, leaf-out); field remeasurement
# 2019-2021; satellites June-September 2019-2025. Footprints cut or harvested between the ALS flight and the
# satellite date (MRNF polygons) are kept apart.
# Forest type: from the field tree tally (live basal area); for a footprint, the type of the nearest PEP plot
# when that plot is within 250 m (otherwise no type).
#
# Input   data/derived/why/* (09 and 10), data/study_area/upe1415_study_area.shp
# Output  docs/assets/img/why/11-18_*.png, outputs/why/numbers_why.txt, outputs/why/*.csv
# Run     Rscript scripts/11_footprint_figures.R      (~5 min)
###############################################################################
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(scales)
  library(data.table); library(terra); library(lidR)
})
sf_use_s2(FALSE); options(lidR.progress = FALSE); invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C"))
ROOT <- Sys.getenv("EXERCISE_ROOT", ".")
AD   <- Sys.getenv("WHY_DIR", if (file.exists(file.path(ROOT, "data/derived/why/als_at_gedi.csv")))
  file.path(ROOT, "data/derived/why") else file.path(ROOT, "data/why"))   # tables of 09 and 10: yours, else the provided ones
CHMD <- Sys.getenv("WHY_CACHE", file.path(AD, "als_cache"))                 # per-tile CHMs written by 10
FIG  <- Sys.getenv("WHY_FIG", file.path(ROOT, "docs/assets/img/why")); OUTC <- Sys.getenv("WHY_OUT", file.path(ROOT, "outputs/why"))
dir.create(FIG, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE); dir.create(OUTC, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
# (the helpers of that file are defined in the 'Helpers' chunks at the top)
set.seed(42)
NUM <- file.path(OUTC, "numbers_why.txt"); cat("", file = NUM)
say <- function(...) { s <- sprintf(...); cat(s, "\n"); cat(s, "\n", file = NUM, append = TRUE) }

# --- look ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SENSOR <- c("ICESat-2 ATL08" = "#2a78d6", "GEDI L2A" = "#eb6834")
SENS_LEV <- c("GEDI L2A", "ICESat-2 ATL08")                                 # facet order
H_PAL  <- c("#eef6e9", "#b9dcaa", "#74b96a", "#2f8a3e", "#0d5226")
FT_PAL <- c("Softwood" = "#1f7a4d", "Mixed" = "#7d55d0", "Hardwood" = "#c47a00", "Open / regenerating" = "#8e8e8e")
KEEP_PAL <- c("Kept by default" = "#333333", "Dropped by default" = "#b07d00")
DIST_PAL <- c("No event" = "#333333", "Partial cut / tending" = "#c47a00", "Harvest (stand-replacing)" = "#c2479a")
INK2 <- "grey35"
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
                  plot.title.position = "plot", plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2),
                  plot.caption = element_text(colour = INK2, hjust = 0), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")))
save <- function(p, f, w, h) { ggsave(file.path(FIG, f), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 200, bg = "white"); cat("  wrote", f, "\n") }
fmt <- function(x, d = 0) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
stats_pair <- function(s, a) {
  ok <- is.finite(s) & is.finite(a); s <- s[ok]; a <- a[ok]; d <- s - a
  data.table(n = length(d), r = cor(s, a), bias = mean(d), med_bias = median(d), rmse = sqrt(mean(d^2)),
             mae = mean(abs(d)), within3 = mean(abs(d) <= 3))
}
stat_lab <- function(st, unit = "m") sprintf("n = %s\nr = %.2f\nbias = %+.1f %s\nRMSE = %.1f %s", fmt(st$n), st$r, st$bias, unit, st$rmse, unit)
ci <- function(x, pass, fun = mean, B = 400) { b <- as.numeric(boot_pass(x, pass, fun, B)); list(lo = b[1], hi = b[2]) }

# --- data ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
tiles <- fread(file.path(AD, "tiles_upe.csv"))
tiles[, als_date := as.Date(als_date)]
tiles[, path := file.path(Sys.getenv("LAZ_DIR", file.path(ROOT, "data/raw/laz")), tile_file_name)]   # LAZ only needed for figure 12
dm <- function(d) paste(as.integer(format(d, "%d")), format(d, "%b"))
spr <- tiles[month(als_date) %in% 5:6, range(als_date)]; lat <- tiles[!month(als_date) %in% 5:6, range(als_date)]
S_SPRING <- sprintf("Spring %s (%s\u2013%s, leaf-out)", year(spr[1]), dm(spr[1]), dm(spr[2]))
S_LATE   <- sprintf("Late summer %s (%s\u2013%s, leaf-on)", year(lat[1]), dm(lat[1]), dm(lat[2]))
SEASON_PAL <- setNames(c("#c2479a", "#5b8c00"), c(S_SPRING, S_LATE))
tiles[, als_season := factor(ifelse(month(als_date) %in% 5:6, S_SPRING, S_LATE), levels = c(S_LATE, S_SPRING))]
tinfo <- tiles[, .(tile_file_name, als_date, als_season, CODE_EPSG, path)]
ws <- fread(file.path(AD, "als_tile_wall_to_wall.csv"))

plots <- fread(file.path(AD, "plots_upe.csv"))
plots <- merge(plots, tinfo[, .(tile_file_name, als_season)], by = "tile_file_name")
plots[, forest_type := factor(forest_type, levels = names(FT_PAL))]
pchk <- merge(fread(file.path(AD, "als_at_plots_check.csv")), plots[, intersect(c("plot_id", "zq95", "zq50", "canopy_cover_2m_fr"), names(plots)), with = FALSE], by = "plot_id")

sg <- fread(file.path(AD, "samples_gedi.csv"), colClasses = list(character = "time"))
ag <- fread(file.path(AD, "als_at_gedi.csv"), colClasses = list(character = "time"))[, tile_file_name := NULL]
G <- merge(sg, ag, by = c("time", "beam"))
G <- merge(G, tinfo[, .(tile_file_name, als_date, als_season)], by = "tile_file_name")
G[, `:=`(date = as.Date(substr(time, 1, 10)), h = pmax(rh98, 0), pass = paste(orbit, beam),
         night = solar_elevation < 0, power = beam %in% c(5, 6, 8, 11))]
G[, `:=`(year = year(date), month = month(date), gap = as.numeric(date - als_date) / 365.25)]
G <- G[als_n >= 100]

sa <- fread(file.path(AD, "samples_atl08.csv"), colClasses = list(character = "time_ns"))
aa <- fread(file.path(AD, "als_at_atl08.csv"), colClasses = list(character = "time_ns"))[, tile_file_name := NULL]
A <- merge(sa, aa, by = c("time_ns", "rgt", "cycle", "gt", "segment_id_beg"))
A <- merge(A, tinfo[, .(tile_file_name, als_date, als_season)], by = "tile_file_name")
A[, `:=`(date = as.Date(substr(time_ns, 1, 10)), h = fifelse(is.na(h_canopy), 0, h_canopy),
         h_als = fifelse(als_n_can < 3 | is.na(als_p98_can), 0, als_p98_can), strong = spot %in% c(1, 3, 5),
         night = solar_elevation < 0, pass = paste(rgt, gt, substr(time_ns, 1, 10)),
         ph_frac = n_ca_photons / (n_ca_photons + n_te_photons))]
A[, `:=`(year = year(date), month = month(date), gap = as.numeric(date - als_date) / 365.25)]
A <- A[als_n >= 300]

# disturbance status AT THE SATELLITE DATE: an MRNF event between the ALS year and the satellite year
dstat <- function(ev, yr_ev, yr_sat) factor(fifelse(ev == "none" | is.na(yr_ev) | yr_ev > yr_sat, "No event",
                                             fifelse(ev == "harvest (stand-replacing)", "Harvest (stand-replacing)",
                                                     fifelse(ev == "partial cut / tending", "Partial cut / tending", "Other"))),
                                             levels = c(names(DIST_PAL), "Other"))
G[, dist := dstat(post_als_event, post_als_year, year)]; A[, dist := dstat(post_als_event, post_als_year, year)]
G[, ft := factor(fifelse(near_plot_dist <= 250, near_forest_type, NA_character_), levels = names(FT_PAL))]
A[, ft := factor(fifelse(near_plot_dist <= 250, near_forest_type, NA_character_), levels = names(FT_PAL))]
G[, default := leaf_off_flag == 0 & sensitivity >= 0.95 & h <= 60]
A[, default := segment_snowcover == 1 & strong & h <= 60]
Gc <- G[default & dist == "No event"]; Ac <- A[default & dist == "No event"]       # the clean sets

say("ALS: %d plots in %d tiles; %s; %s", nrow(plots), nrow(tiles), S_LATE, S_SPRING)
say("Plots by forest type: %s", paste(names(table(plots$forest_type)), table(plots$forest_type), collapse = ", "))
say("Footprints with ALS: GEDI %s (default filters + no post-ALS event: %s, %d passes); ATL08 %s (%s, %d passes)",
    fmt(nrow(G)), fmt(nrow(Gc)), uniqueN(Gc$pass), fmt(nrow(A)), fmt(nrow(Ac)), uniqueN(Ac$pass))
say("Post-ALS MRNF events at the satellite date: GEDI %s; ATL08 %s",
    paste(names(table(G$dist)), table(G$dist), collapse = ", "), paste(names(table(A$dist)), table(A$dist), collapse = ", "))

# check: this ALS processing (provider ground, whole-tile TIN) vs data/plot_als_metrics.csv (CSF ground, 30 m clip)
ck <- stats_pair(pchk$als_rh95, pchk$zq95); ck2 <- stats_pair(pchk$als_cover2, pchk$canopy_cover_2m_fr)
say("Check vs the plot ALS table: P95 n=%d r=%.3f bias=%+.2f m RMSE=%.2f m; cover2 r=%.3f bias=%+.3f",
    ck$n, ck$r, ck$bias, ck$rmse, ck2$r, ck2$bias)

###############################################################################
# 11 Design: where the plots are and when each instrument looked
###############################################################################
cat("figure 11\n")
area <- st_read(file.path(ROOT, "data/study_area/upe1415_study_area.shp"), quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(2950)
p11a <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data = area, fill = "grey97", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(data = plots, aes(x2950, y2950, colour = forest_type, shape = als_season), size = 1.5, stroke = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = FT_PAL, name = "Forest type (field)", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = setNames(c(16, 2), c(S_LATE, S_SPRING)), name = "ALS flight") +
  coord_sf(crs = 2950, datum = 4326) + theme(axis.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
                                             legend.box = "vertical", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 2.5)), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  labs(title = sprintf("%d PEP plots with ALS", nrow(plots)),
       subtitle = "Each plot sits in a 1 km ALS tile; satellite samples\ninside those tiles are compared with the ALS")
mon <- function(d, what) d[, .N, by = .(m = as.Date(format(date, "%Y-%m-15")))][, what := what][]
tl <- rbind(mon(tiles[, .(date = als_date)], "ALS flights (tiles)"),
            plots[, .N, by = .(m = as.Date(sprintf("%d-07-01", field_year)))][, what := "Field remeasurement (plots)"],
            mon(Ac, "ICESat-2 ATL08 (segments)"), mon(Gc, "GEDI L2A (footprints)"))
tl[, what := factor(what, levels = rev(c("ALS flights (tiles)", "Field remeasurement (plots)",
                                         "ICESat-2 ATL08 (segments)", "GEDI L2A (footprints)")))]
tl <- tl[m >= as.Date("2016-06-01")]
TLCOL <- c("ALS flights (tiles)" = "#333333", "Field remeasurement (plots)" = "#777777",
           "ICESat-2 ATL08 (segments)" = SENSOR[[1]], "GEDI L2A (footprints)" = SENSOR[[2]])
p11b <- ggplot(tl, aes(m, what)) + geom_blank() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-03-17"), xmax = as.Date("2024-04-20"), ymin = 0.5, ymax = 1.5, fill = "grey90") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2023-10-01"), y = 1.38, label = "GEDI stored\non the ISS", size = 2.4, colour = INK2, lineheight = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(size = N, colour = what), alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7, name = "Count per month\n(field: per year)", breaks = c(10, 100, 1000)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = TLCOL, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y", limits = as.Date(c("2017-01-01", "2025-12-31"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "When each instrument looked",
       subtitle = sprintf("Satellites: June\u2013September, default filters, no harvest after the ALS. The gap between ALS and satellite\nis 1\u20138 years (median %.1f years for GEDI, %.1f for ICESat-2).",
                          median(Gc$gap), median(Ac$gap))) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
p11 <- (p11a | p11b) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Comparing the satellites with airborne lidar at the inventory plots",
                  subtitle = "UPE 14\u201315: ALS from the Quebec provincial program (Optech Galaxy, 2.5 pts/m\u00b2 nominal, ~14 measured), PEP permanent plots (11.28 m radius)",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)))
save(p11, "11_als_design_map_timeline.png", 12.5, 6)

###############################################################################
# 12 Same ground, three instruments: one tile, one GEDI footprint, one ATL08 segment
###############################################################################
cat("figure 12 (reads one LAZ tile)\n")
score <- merge(Gc[, .(ng = .N), by = tile_file_name], Ac[, .(na = .N), by = tile_file_name], by = "tile_file_name")
ex_tile <- score[order(-(pmin(na, 20) * 5 + ng))]$tile_file_name[1]
tt <- tiles[tile_file_name == ex_tile]
chm_file <- file.path(CHMD, sub("\\.LAZ$", "_chm_dm.tif", ex_tile))
if (!file.exists(tt$path) || !file.exists(chm_file)) {
  cat("  figure 12 skipped: it needs the LAZ tile", ex_tile, "in", dirname(tt$path), "and its CHM from step 10\n")
} else {
  chm <- rast(chm_file) / 10
  chm2 <- aggregate(chm, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE); cd <- as.data.frame(chm2, xy = TRUE); names(cd)[3] <- "z"
  ge <- Gc[tile_file_name == ex_tile]; ae <- Ac[tile_file_name == ex_tile]
  pe <- plots[tile_file_name == ex_tile]
  pexy <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(pe, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326), tt$CODE_EPSG))
  rect_sf <- function(d, L = 50, W = 7) st_sfc(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
    cx <- d$x_tile[i]; cy <- d$y_tile[i]; ux <- d$ux[i]; uy <- d$uy[i]
    m <- rbind(c(cx - L * ux - W * uy, cy - L * uy + W * ux), c(cx + L * ux - W * uy, cy + L * uy + W * ux),
               c(cx + L * ux + W * uy, cy + L * uy - W * ux), c(cx - L * ux + W * uy, cy - L * uy - W * ux))
    st_polygon(list(rbind(m, m[1, ])))
  }), crs = tt$CODE_EPSG)
  # typical examples: the footprint / segment whose error is closest to the tile's median absolute error
  pick_typ <- function(e) { i <- which.min(abs(abs(e) - median(abs(e)))); i }
  gi <- ge[pick_typ(ge$rh98 - ge$als_rh98)]; ai <- ae[h_als > 5][pick_typ(ae[h_als > 5]$h - ae[h_als > 5]$h_als)]
  las <- readLAS(tt$path, select = "xyzrnc", filter = "-drop_withheld -drop_class 7 18")
  las <- normalize_height(las, tin(), use_class = 2L); las <- filter_poi(las, Z >= -2, Z <= 60); las$Z[las$Z < 0] <- 0
  lg <- clip_circle(las, gi$x_tile, gi$y_tile, 12.5)
  la <- clip_roi(las, rect_sf(ai)); if (is.list(la) && !inherits(la, "LAS")) la <- la[[1]]
  rm(las); invisible(gc())
  p12a <- ggplot() + geom_raster(data = cd, aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = H_PAL, limits = c(0, 30), oob = squish, name = "ALS canopy\nheight (m)") +
    geom_sf(data = st_buffer(st_as_sf(ge, coords = c("x_tile", "y_tile"), crs = tt$CODE_EPSG), 12.5), fill = NA,
            colour = SENSOR[[2]], linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_sf(data = rect_sf(ae), fill = NA, colour = SENSOR[[1]], linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_sf(data = st_buffer(st_as_sf(data.frame(x = pexy[, 1], y = pexy[, 2]), coords = c("x", "y"), crs = tt$CODE_EPSG), 11.28),
            fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_sf(data = st_buffer(st_as_sf(gi, coords = c("x_tile", "y_tile"), crs = tt$CODE_EPSG), 25), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
    geom_sf(data = st_buffer(st_centroid(rect_sf(ai)), 60), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "22") +
    ggspatial::annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.25, text_cex = 0.7) +
    coord_sf(crs = tt$CODE_EPSG, datum = NA, expand = FALSE) + theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2, size = 8.5)) +
    labs(title = sprintf("One ALS tile (1 km\u00b2, flown %s %d)", dm(tt$als_date), year(tt$als_date)),
         subtitle = sprintf("Orange circles: %d GEDI footprints. Blue rectangles: %d ICESat-2 segments.\nBlack circle: PEP plot. Dashed: the two samples on the right.", nrow(ge), nrow(ae)))
  side <- function(l, cx, cy, ux = 1, uy = 0, off = 0) data.table(s = (l$X - cx) * ux + (l$Y - cy) * uy + off, z = l$Z, g = l$Classification == 2L)
  sg1 <- side(lg, gi$x_tile, gi$y_tile)
  hl <- function(v, lab, col, lt) data.table(v = v, lab = lab, col = col, lt = lt)
  lines_g <- rbind(hl(gi$rh98, "GEDI RH98", SENSOR[[2]], "solid"), hl(gi$rh50, "GEDI RH50", SENSOR[[2]], "22"),
                   hl(gi$als_rh98, "ALS P98", "black", "solid"), hl(gi$als_rh50, "ALS P50", "black", "22"))
  prof_panel <- function(pts, ln, title, sub, xl) {
    ggplot(pts, aes(s, z)) + geom_point(aes(colour = g), size = 0.25, alpha = 0.6, shape = 16) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#8a6d3b", `FALSE` = "#5f9e5a"), labels = c(`TRUE` = "ground", `FALSE` = "other"), name = "ALS return") +
      geom_hline(data = ln, aes(yintercept = v, linetype = lt), colour = ln$col, linewidth = 0.6) +
      scale_linetype_identity() +
      geom_text(data = ln[!grepl("^ALS", lab)], aes(x = min(pts$s), y = v, label = sprintf("%s %.1f m", lab, v)),
                colour = "grey15", hjust = 0, vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5) +
      geom_text(data = ln[grepl("^ALS", lab)], aes(x = max(pts$s), y = v, label = sprintf("%s %.1f m", lab, v)),
                colour = "grey15", hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, size = 2.5) +
      labs(x = xl, y = "Height above ground (m)", title = title, subtitle = sub) +
      theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(size = 10), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))
  }
  p12b <- prof_panel(sg1, lines_g, "A GEDI footprint, seen from the side",
                     sprintf("%s ALS returns within 12.5 m; shot %s, %s", fmt(nrow(sg1)), format(gi$date, "%d %b %Y"), ifelse(gi$night, "night", "day")),
                     "West\u2013east position in the footprint (m)")
  sa1 <- side(la, ai$x_tile, ai$y_tile, ai$ux, ai$uy, 50)
  lines_a <- rbind(hl(ai$h, "ATL08 h_canopy", SENSOR[[1]], "solid"), hl(ai$ch_p50, "ATL08 canopy P50", SENSOR[[1]], "22"),
                   hl(ai$h_als, "ALS P98 > 0.5 m", "black", "solid"), hl(ai$als_p50_can, "ALS P50 > 0.5 m", "black", "22"))
  p12c <- prof_panel(sa1, lines_a, "An ICESat-2 segment, seen from the side",
                     sprintf("%s ALS returns in the 100 \u00d7 14 m segment; %s beam, %s, %s", fmt(nrow(sa1)), ifelse(ai$strong, "strong", "weak"),
                             format(ai$date, "%d %b %Y"), ifelse(ai$night, "night", "day")), "Distance along the track (m)")
  pcs <- seq(0, 100, 1)
  cg <- rbind(data.table(p = c(10, 25, 50, 75, 90, 95, 98, 100), h = unlist(gi[, .(rh10, rh25, rh50, rh75, rh90, rh95, rh98, rh100)]), src = "GEDI RH"),
              data.table(p = pcs, h = quantile(lg$Z, pcs / 100, names = FALSE), src = "ALS, all returns"))
  ca <- rbind(data.table(p = c(seq(10, 95, 5), 98), h = c(unlist(ai[, paste0("ch_p", seq(10, 95, 5)), with = FALSE]), ai$h), src = "ATL08 canopy percentiles"),
              data.table(p = pcs, h = quantile(la$Z[la$Z > 0.5], pcs / 100, names = FALSE), src = "ALS, returns > 0.5 m"))
  curve_panel <- function(d, col, title) {
    ggplot(d, aes(h, p)) + geom_line(data = d[!grepl("^ALS", src)], colour = col, linewidth = 0.7) +
      geom_point(data = d[!grepl("^ALS", src)], colour = col, size = 1.6) +
      geom_line(data = d[grepl("^ALS", src)], colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
      labs(x = "Height (m)", y = "Percentile", title = title) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
  }
  p12d <- curve_panel(cg, SENSOR[[2]], "Same footprint: RH curve") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 8, hjust = 1.05, size = 2.5, colour = "grey15", label = "dots: GEDI   black: ALS (all returns)")
  p12e <- curve_panel(ca, SENSOR[[1]], "Same segment: canopy percentiles") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 8, hjust = 1.05, size = 2.5, colour = "grey15", label = "dots: ATL08   black: ALS (> 0.5 m)")
  p12 <- (p12a | ((p12b | p12d) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1))) / ((p12c | p12e) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.6, 1)))) +
    plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.45)) +
    plot_annotation(title = "The same ground seen by ALS, GEDI and ICESat-2",
                    subtitle = "GEDI RH metrics are percentiles of returned energy from the ground up, so their ALS counterpart is the percentile of ALL returns.\nATL08 canopy metrics are percentiles of canopy photons only (from about 0.5 m above the ground), so their ALS counterpart is the percentile of returns above 0.5 m.",
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)))
  save(p12, "12_same_ground_three_instruments.png", 14, 7.6)
}

###############################################################################

cat("figure 13\n")
pairs <- list(
  list(G = Gc, s = "rh98", a = "als_rh98", sen = "GEDI L2A", lab = "Top height: GEDI RH98 vs ALS P98 (all returns)"),
  list(G = Gc, s = "rh75", a = "als_rh75", sen = "GEDI L2A", lab = "GEDI RH75 vs ALS P75 (all returns)"),
  list(G = Gc, s = "rh50", a = "als_rh50", sen = "GEDI L2A", lab = "GEDI RH50 vs ALS P50 (all returns)"),
  list(G = Ac, s = "h", a = "h_als", sen = "ICESat-2 ATL08", lab = "Top height: ATL08 h_canopy vs ALS P98 (returns > 0.5 m)"),
  list(G = Ac[h > 2 & h_als > 2], s = "ch_p75", a = "als_p75_can", sen = "ICESat-2 ATL08", lab = "ATL08 canopy P75 vs ALS P75 (returns > 0.5 m)"),
  list(G = Ac[h > 2 & h_als > 2], s = "ch_p50", a = "als_p50_can", sen = "ICESat-2 ATL08", lab = "ATL08 canopy P50 vs ALS P50 (returns > 0.5 m)"))
agree <- rbindlist(lapply(pairs, function(p) cbind(sensor = p$sen, metric = p$s, stats_pair(p$G[[p$s]], p$G[[p$a]]))))
alt <- Ac[h > 2 & h_als > 2]
agree <- rbind(agree, cbind(sensor = "ICESat-2 ATL08", metric = c("h (ALS > 2 m)", "ch_p50 (ALS > 2 m)"),
                            rbind(stats_pair(Ac$h, fifelse(Ac$als_n_can2 < 3 | is.na(Ac$als_p98_can2), 0, Ac$als_p98_can2)),
                                  stats_pair(alt$ch_p50, alt$als_p50_can2))))
fwrite(agree, file.path(OUTC, "footprint_agreement.csv"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(agree))) with(agree[i], say("Footprint %s %s: n=%d r=%.2f bias=%+.2f RMSE=%.2f MAE=%.2f within3m=%.0f%%",
                                                    sensor, metric, n, r, bias, rmse, mae, 100 * within3))
scat <- function(p) {
  d <- data.table(s = p$G[[p$s]], a = p$G[[p$a]]); st <- stats_pair(d$s, d$a)
  lim <- c(min(0, quantile(c(d$s, d$a), 0.001, na.rm = TRUE)), quantile(c(d$s, d$a), 0.999, na.rm = TRUE))
  ggplot(d, aes(a, s)) + geom_bin2d(binwidth = c(0.75, 0.75)) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#eeeeee", high = SENSOR[[p$sen]], trans = "log10", name = "Samples") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "black") +
    annotate("label", x = lim[1], y = lim[2], label = stat_lab(st), hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 2.6,
             fill = alpha("white", 0.85), border.colour = NA, colour = "grey15") +
    coord_fixed(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) + labs(x = "ALS on the same ground (m)", y = paste(p$sen, "(m)"), subtitle = p$lab) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey15"), legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"))
}
p13 <- wrap_plots(lapply(pairs, scat), ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Footprint by footprint: how close each satellite metric is to its ALS counterpart",
                  subtitle = sprintf("Default filters, June\u2013September 2019\u20132025, footprints without a harvest or partial cut after the ALS flight. Line = 1:1. ATL08 P75/P50 only where both\nsee canopy taller than 2 m. GEDI: %s footprints, %d passes; ICESat-2: %s segments, %d passes.",
                                     fmt(nrow(Gc)), uniqueN(Gc$pass), fmt(nrow(Ac)), uniqueN(Ac$pass)),
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)))
save(p13, "13_footprint_agreement.png", 13, 8.6)

###############################################################################
# 14 By forest type and ALS season
